sections.Profile:
The "Last Action Hero" pinball machine, produced by Data East in 1993, is based on the movie of the same name starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Designed by Joe Kaminkow and others, this machine features a distinctive auto plunger shaped like a Ruger Blackhawk .45 caliber pistol, and includes engaging elements like a shaker motor, captive balls, and a crane toy that moves the ball across the playfield.
